landing.heroTitle: Know when to paint — and what system holds up.
landing.heroBody: PaintDay scores the weather. System Match cites real manufacturer data sheets. CoverCalc keeps the math honest. Built for crews who refuse to guess.
landing.step1Body: We pull forecast humidity, dew point, wind, precip, and freeze risk for that location.
landing.step2Body: A 0–100 PaintDay score, in plain English, with the factors that actually wreck a coating.
landing.step3Body: A 14-day exterior calendar so you stop wasting a crew day on a 60% shower.
landing.systemsTitle: System Match, not a SKU dump
landing.systemsBody: Prep + primer + topcoat, ranked across manufacturers, each with a TDS citation. We never hide a brand. We never pretend to be one.

factorHelp.precip: Wet film fails. Under 20% chance is a go; rain now is a no.
factorHelp.humidity: Too wet and latex blushes and stays tacky. Too dry and it flashes.
factorHelp.temperature: Cold = won’t film. Hot = flashes and lap marks.
factorHelp.dewPoint: Close to dew, walls sweat. Don’t paint wet siding.
factorHelp.wind: Wind dries spray in the air and throws overspray on cars.
factorHelp.freeze: If it hits 32°F before the coat cures, the film can fail.

about.title: Independent on purpose
about.body1: PainterApps exists so a painter can answer three questions without calling a brand desk: When is it smart to coat? What system actually fits this substrate? What will it take in material?
about.body2: We are not Sherwin-Williams, PPG, Behr, Benjamin Moore, or anyone else. Manufacturer names appear because hiding them would be dishonest. Recommendations cite the technical data sheet that was in our corpus at publish time — you still verify the current revision.
about.body3: Over time we will deepen the TDS corpus, keep PaintDay honest against real weather, and ship estimating as its own product surface. The north star does not change: tools that make a painting company look as professional as the work.

legal.footerDisclaimer: Independent product. Not affiliated with any paint manufacturer. Guidance only — verify current TDS and local codes.

privacy.p1: PainterApps (“we”) operates painterapps.com. This policy describes what we collect and why.
privacy.p2: Account data. If you create an account, Supabase Auth stores your email and authentication details. We keep a profile row (language, units) and any locations or jobs you save.
privacy.p3: Weather lookups. ZIP and city searches are sent to geocoding and forecast providers (currently Zippopotam.us and Open-Meteo) to compute PaintDay scores. We may cache forecasts by ZIP for under an hour.
privacy.p4: Cookies and local storage. We store language preference and session cookies required to keep you signed in. Theme (light or dark) is stored in your browser, not as a cookie.
privacy.p5: Analytics. We use Vercel Analytics for aggregate page views. We do not sell personal information.
privacy.p6: Retention. Saved locations and jobs remain until you delete them or close your account. Contact hello@painterapps.com to request deletion.
privacy.p7: We do not use your job data to train public models. We do not share manufacturer-identifying usage with manufacturers.

terms.p1: By using painterapps.com you agree to these terms.
terms.p2: Not professional advice. PaintDay scores, System Match results, and CoverCalc outputs are decision-support tools. They are not a specification, a warranty, or a substitute for the manufacturer’s current technical data sheet, SDS, or applicable building codes.
terms.p3: Independence. PainterApps is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any paint manufacturer. Product names appear as factual citations.
terms.p4: Accounts. You are responsible for activity under your login. Do not share credentials.
terms.p5: Acceptable use. Do not scrape, overload, or reverse engineer the service; do not use it to produce misleading specifications.
terms.p6: Limitation of liability. To the fullest extent permitted by law, PainterApps is not liable for coating failures, weather misses, or job-cost errors arising from use of the site.
terms.p7: Changes. We may update these terms. Continued use after an update constitutes acceptance.
